checks.name: F1_hermitian_bilinears
checks.detail: real (Hermitian) bilinears: Psibar P_X Psi, i Psibar S^{ab} P_X Psi, i Psibar gamma^a Psi, Psibar gamma^a Gamma Psi; Psibar gamma^a P_L Psi is neither real nor imaginary (no Hermitian left-handed vector current exists)

checks.name: F1_convective_current
checks.detail: sigma16 P_X is real and symmetric, so j_X^M = i(Psibar P_X D^M Psi - (D^M Psibar) P_X Psi) is real

checks.name: F1_kinetic_term_real
checks.detail: (sigma16 gamma^a)^T = -sigma16 gamma^a: (1/2)(Psibar gamma^M D_M Psi - (D_M Psibar) gamma^M Psi) is real; no factor i is needed

checks.name: F2_even_odd_chirality
checks.detail: for every one of the 256 products: an even number of gamma matrices gives only P_L-P_L and P_R-P_R terms, an odd number only P_L-P_R terms

checks.name: F2_adjoint_commutes_with_chirality
checks.detail: sigma16 commutes with Gamma (sigma16 is a product of four gamma matrices): (P_X Psi)bar = Psibar P_X

checks.name: F3_krein_operator
checks.detail: B = i sigma16 gamma^(x4) is a Hermitian involution (B^2 = 1, eigenvalues +1 and -1 eight times each); it commutes with gamma^(x0), ..., gamma^(x4) and the mass term, anticommutes with gamma^(x5), gamma^(x6), gamma^(x7) and with Gamma

checks.name: F3_krein_signature
checks.detail: the conserved charge density i Psibar gamma^(x4) Psi = Psi^dagger B Psi has the signature (8, 8)

checks.name: F4_four_dimensional_chirality
checks.detail: Gamma_4 = i T1 T2 T3 T4 is a Hermitian involution anticommuting with gamma^(x1..x4) and commuting with gamma^(x0), gamma^(x5..x7); Gamma_int = i T0 T5 T6 T7 squares to 1; Gamma = -1 Gamma_4 Gamma_int

checks.name: F4_krein_and_4d_chirality
checks.detail: B commutes with Gamma_4: each half B = +-1 contains both four-dimensional chiralities

checks.name: F5_gauge_boson_masses
checks.detail: for Phi = (A, v)/sqrt 2 (A real): one zero eigenvalue (the photon), m_W^2 = g^2 (v^2 + A^2)/4 (twice), m_Z^2 = (g^2 + g'^2)(v^2 + A^2)/4

checks.name: F5_photon_direction
checks.detail: the photon is A = (g B - g' n^I W^I)/sqrt(g^2 + g'^2) with n = (2Av, 0, A^2 - v^2)/(A^2 + v^2): for A = 0 the usual (g B + g' W^3)/sqrt(g^2 + g'^2), for A != 0 rotated towards W^1

checks.name: F5_isospin_charge_density
checks.detail: the ad hoc vacuum carries the weak-isospin current J^2_{x4} = (i/2)[Phi^dagger tau^2 d_4 Phi - c.c.] = a40 v v_A e^{-2 a40 x4} (J^1 = J^3 = 0): a uniform charge density of the second isospin direction, which the Gauss law of W^2 must balance

checks.name: F5_higgs_residual_upper
checks.detail: with mu^2 = -lambda v^2 the upper component A = v_A e^{-2 a40 x4} leaves the residual -(4 a40^2 - 6 a40 u) A - lambda A^3 in its field equation (u = b4'/b4): the ad hoc vacuum is an approximate solution, exact only as A -> 0

checks.name: F6_yukawa_invariance
checks.detail: the four Yukawa terms have total hypercharge 0: {'Qbar Phitilde u_R': '0', 'Qbar Phi d_R': '0', 'lbar Phi e_R': '0', 'lbar Phitilde nu_R': '0'}

checks.name: F6_anomalies
checks.detail: per generation: SU(3)^2U(1) = 0, SU(2)^2U(1) = 0, U(1)^3 = 0, grav^2U(1) = 0, SU(3)^3 = 0; 3 x 4 = 12 SU(2) doublets (even, no Witten anomaly)
